Prophecy: Blessing to All Nations Through Abraham
ProphecySummary: God promised Abraham that through his offspring all families of the earth would be blessed. This was more than land and descendants — it pointed to a blessing that would reach the Gentile world.
Fulfillment: Paul identifies the offspring as Christ, through whom the blessing of Abraham and the gift of the Spirit have come to the nations. Every believer from every people group is living proof of this promise being kept.
RelatedEvents: Call of Abraham; The Crucifixion; Pentecost
